description: Evaluate a canonical EvaluationContext (gates, artifacts, rules, compliance) and return an EvaluationResult (ADR-0073 envelope). Stateless: product/tenant/initiative are opaque context only.

corePath.description: Optional explicit path to the Evolith Core repository

design.description: Design facet (ADR-0104). Carries the confirmed topology composition as design.topologyConfirmedRefs: string[]. Same field and shape the REST EvaluationContextDto accepts (GT-688).

waiverStore.description: Optional waiver store path (default: <workspaceRef>/.evolith/waivers.json). Read-only: this tool honours approved waivers, it cannot create or approve them (GT-677).

workspaceRef.description: Opaque workspace reference (locally: a path). Default: cwd.

name: evolith-evaluate

outputSchema.description: Envelope returned by every Evolith MCP tool, mirrored verbatim in `structuredContent`. `success: true` carries `data`; `success: false` carries `error`. Envelope schema version 1.0.0.

data.description: Tool-specific payload, present when `success` is true. Not narrowed for this tool yet — per-operation payload schemas are generated from the capability manifest (GT-583).

error.description: Present when `success` is false. `code` is machine-readable and append-only.

code.description: Stable Evolith error code. FORBIDDEN covers every ABAC / scope / approval refusal.

meta.description: ADR-0073 envelope metadata. Identical across the CLI, REST and MCP surfaces.

command.description: ADR-0073 canonical name of the invoked operation.

context.description: Verbatim echo of the caller-supplied execution context.

durationMs.description: Server-side wall time of the call.

schemaVersion.description: Pinned envelope shape version. Bumped only on a breaking envelope change.

success.description: Whether the operation completed. Not the governance verdict.

outputSchema.title: EvolithMcpOutputEnvelope
